subject: Chemistry
title: Organic Chemistry: Some Basic Principles and Techniques
summary: Carbon chaar bonds banata hai (tetravalency), lambi chains (catenation) aur multiple bonds. Hybridisation (sp³, sp², sp) shape aur bond angles tay karta hai.

Electron displacement effects — inductive (σ bonds), resonance/mesomeric (π systems), hyperconjugation aur electromeric effect — carbocation, carbanion aur free radical ki stability aur acids/bases ki strength samjhaate hain.

Reactions tab hoti hain jab nucleophile (electron-rich) electrophile (electron-poor) par attack kare. Bonds homolytic (free radicals) ya heterolytic (ions) tarike se toot-te hain; reactions substitution, addition, elimination ya rearrangement hoti hain.
Purification (crystallisation, distillation, chromatography), qualitative tests (Lassaigne's test) aur quantitative estimation (Dumas, Kjeldahl, Carius, Liebig) chapter ka practical hissa hain.

formulas.name: Hybridisation from bonds
formulas.when: Carbon par shape aur bond angle.
formulas.mistake: Atom ke around σ bonds (aur lone pairs) gino, total bonds nahi — galti mat karo.

formulas.name: Degree of unsaturation (DBE)
formulas.when: Molecular formula se rings + π bonds.
formulas.mistake: O aur S ignore karo; halogens ko H jaisa gino — bhoolo mat.

formulas.name: Inductive effect
formulas.formula: −I: NO₂ > CN > F > Cl > Br > I > OH;  +I: (CH₃)₃C > (CH₃)₂CH > CH₃CH₂ > CH₃
formulas.mistake: Inductive effect doori ke saath jaldi khatam hota hai (~3 carbons ke baad negligible) — door tak mat lagao.

formulas.name: Resonance (mesomeric) effect
formulas.when: Conjugated species ki stability, directing effects.

formulas.name: Carbocation stability
formulas.when: Rearrangements aur SN1/E1 rates predict karna.

formulas.name: C–H bond dissociation energy
formulas.formula: sp C–H > sp² C–H > sp³ C–H  (more s-character → shorter, stronger bond);  allylic/benzylic C–H weakest (gives a resonance-stabilised radical)
formulas.note: Kamzor C–H ⇔ zyada stable radical banta hai (free-radical stability wala hi order).

formulas.name: Carbanion stability
formulas.formula: CH₃⁻ > 1° > 2° > 3° (opposite of carbocations); stabilised by −I/−R groups and sp character

formulas.name: Hyperconjugation
formulas.formula: more α-hydrogens → more hyperconjugation → greater stability
formulas.note: Isi se samajh aata hai ki 3° carbocations aur zyada substituted alkenes zyada stable kyun hain.

formulas.name: Kjeldahl's method
formulas.formula: % N = (1.4 × N_acid × V_acid used)/mass of compound
formulas.mistake: Nitro, azo compounds ya ring mein N (pyridine) ke liye nahi chalta — dhyan rakho.

formulas.name: Carius method
formulas.formula: % X = (atomic mass of X × mass of AgX)/(molar mass of AgX × mass of compound) × 100;  % S via BaSO₄

formulas.name: Liebig's method (C and H)
formulas.formula: % C = (12/44) × (mass CO₂/mass compound) × 100;  % H = (2/18) × (mass H₂O/mass compound) × 100

examples.title: Kjeldahl
examples.problem: 0.5 g compound se bani NH₃ 10 mL 1 M H₂SO₄ ko neutralise karti hai. % N?
examples.solution: 10 mL 1 M H₂SO₄ 0.02 mol NH₃ ko neutralise karta hai = 0.28 g N. % N = 56%.

examples.title: Carius
examples.problem: 0.20 g compound se 0.287 g AgCl. % Cl?

examples.title: Liebig
examples.problem: 0.30 g compound se 0.44 g CO₂. % C?

examples.title: Acid strength
examples.solution: Cl₂CHCOOH > FCH₂COOH > ClCH₂COOH > CH₃COOH — zyada aur strong −I groups carboxylate ion ko stable karte hain.

examples.title: Lassaigne's test
examples.problem: Sodium fusion extract FeCl₃ ke saath blood-red colour deta hai. Kaunse elements?
examples.solution: N aur S dono: ye NaSCN banate hain, jo blood-red [Fe(SCN)]²⁺ deta hai. Sirf N → Prussian blue; sirf S → sodium nitroprusside ke saath violet.

topics.title: Classification and homologous series
topics.explain: Organic compounds acyclic (open chain: alkanes, alkenes, alkynes) ya cyclic hote hain — alicyclic (cyclohexane) ya aromatic (benzenoid jaise benzene, non-benzenoid jaise tropolone, aur heterocyclic jaise pyridine, furan). Inhe functional group se bhi group kiya jaata hai. Homologous series ek family hai jismein functional group same hota hai aur lagataar members mein –CH₂– (14 u) ka farak hota hai: general formula same (alkanes CₙH₂ₙ₊₂, alkenes CₙH₂ₙ, alkynes CₙH₂ₙ₋₂, alcohols CₙH₂ₙ₊₁OH), chemical properties milti-julti, aur physical properties (boiling point) molar mass ke saath dheere-dheere badalti hain.

topics.title: IUPAC nomenclature
topics.explain: Principal functional group wali sabse lambi chain lo, use itna number karo ki us group ko sabse chhota locant mile, substituents alphabetical order mein. Suffix priority: –COOH > –SO₃H > –COOR > –COCl > –CONH₂ > –CN > –CHO > >C=O > –OH > –NH₂ > C=C > C≡C.

topics.title: Isomerism
topics.explain: Structural: chain, position, functional group, metamerism, tautomerism (keto–enol). Stereoisomerism: geometrical (C=C ya rings mein cis/trans) aur optical (chiral carbon, non-superimposable mirror images).

topics.title: Bond fission and reactive intermediates
topics.explain: Homolytic fission se free radicals (light/peroxides mein); heterolytic fission se carbocations aur carbanions. Carbocations planar (sp²), carbanions pyramidal (sp³), free radicals planar.

topics.title: Nucleophiles and electrophiles
topics.explain: Nucleophiles: OH⁻, CN⁻, NH₃, H₂O, ROH (lone pairs ya negative charge). Electrophiles: H⁺, NO₂⁺, carbocations, BF₃, AlCl₃ (electron-deficient). Reactions: substitution, addition, elimination, rearrangement.

topics.title: Electromeric effect
topics.explain: Reagent paas aane par π electrons ka ek atom ki taraf temporary, poora shift — sirf reagent ki maujoodgi mein (permanent inductive aur resonance effects se alag).

topics.title: Purification methods
topics.explain: Crystallisation (solubility difference), sublimation (camphor, naphthalene), simple distillation (bada bp difference), fractional distillation (paas ke bp), reduced pressure par distillation (bp par toot jaaye), steam distillation (steam-volatile, immiscible — aniline), differential extraction, aur chromatography (adsorption ya partition; Rf = compound ki doori/solvent ki doori).

topics.title: Qualitative analysis
topics.explain: Sodium fusion (Lassaigne) N, S, X ko NaCN, Na₂S, NaX mein badalta hai. N: FeSO₄ + FeCl₃ se Prussian blue. S: lead acetate se kaala PbS, nitroprusside se violet. Halogens: HNO₃ ke saath ubaal kar AgNO₃ (safed AgCl NH₃ mein ghulta, halka peela AgBr, peela AgI). Br vs I (layer test): sodium-fusion extract + chlorine water + CHCl₃/CCl₄ — Cl₂ halogen ko free karke organic layer mein bhejta hai: violet = iodine, orange/brown = bromine.

ratta: −I: NO₂ > CN > F > Cl > Br > I;  +I: tert-butyl > isopropyl > ethyl > methyl.
Kjeldahl % N = 1.4 NV/w (not for nitro/azo/ring N).
N + S → blood red;  N → Prussian blue.
C–H BDE: sp > sp² > sp³;  allylic/benzylic C–H sabse kamzor.
Layer test (Cl₂ water + CHCl₃): violet = I, orange/brown = Br.
